mentions.heading: Labor-intensive business with unions; strikes or work disruptions could hurt operations
mentions.detail: Unionized, works council workforce; customer plant strikes matter—UAW strikes at GM, Ford, Stellantis in September 2023 lasted over six weeks
mentions.quote: In addition, certain UAW-represented employees at GM, Ford and Stellantis initiated labor strikes in September 2023, lasting more than six weeks in duration.
